description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing groups in the Mattermost application, including linking/unlinking syncables, fetching groups, creating groups, and managing group membership.

methods.name: linkGroupSyncable
methods.description: Links a group to a syncable entity (team or channel) and dispatches corresponding Redux actions.

methods.name: unlinkGroupSyncable
methods.description: Unlinks a group from a syncable entity and dispatches corresponding Redux actions.

methods.name: getGroupSyncables
methods.description: Fetches syncables (teams or channels) associated with a group.

methods.name: patchGroupSyncable
methods.description: Updates a syncable association for a group.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific group by ID.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of groups based on provided options.

methods.name: getGroupsNotAssociatedToTeam
methods.description: Fetches groups not associated with a specific team.

methods.name: getGroupsNotAssociatedToChannel
methods.description: Fetches groups not associated with a specific channel.

methods.name: getAllGroupsAssociatedToTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all groups associated with a team.

methods.name: getAllGroupsAssociatedToChannelsInTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all groups associated with channels in a team.

methods.name: getAllGroupsAssociatedToChannel
methods.description: Retrieves all groups associated with a channel.

methods.name: getGroupsAssociatedToTeam
methods.description: Retrieves groups associated with a team with pagination.

methods.name: getGroupsAssociatedToChannel
methods.description: Retrieves groups associated with a channel with pagination.

methods.name: patchGroup
methods.description: Updates a group's information.

methods.name: getGroupsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves groups for a specific user.

methods.name: getGroupsByNames
methods.description: Retrieves groups matching given names.

methods.name: getGroupsByUserIdPaginated
methods.description: Retrieves paginated groups for a user.

methods.name: getGroupStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a group.

methods.name: createGroupWithUserIds
methods.description: Creates a new group with specified user IDs.

methods.name: addUsersToGroup
methods.description: Adds users to a group.

methods.name: removeUsersFromGroup
methods.description: Removes users from a group.

methods.name: searchGroups
methods.description: Searches for groups based on parameters.

methods.name: archiveGroup
methods.description: Archives a group.

methods.name: restoreGroup
methods.description: Restores an archived group.

methods.name: createGroupTeamsAndChannels
methods.description: Creates default teams and channels for a user in a group context.
